{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Core Navy''' was the military force of the [[Imperial Core]]. Following the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the Navy was augmented by at least sixty [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] from the [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] after [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sil Sorannan]] liberated them from [[Yevetha]] control. By that point, the Navy had a backbone of two [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Groups]], mainly composed of superiority forces to the order of at least ten [[superiority fleet]]s.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
